clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Alterac Valley, Warmaster Laggrond prepares Horde fighters for the Frostwolf clan. He commands from the valley’s entrance in the Alterac Mountains, where warriors answer the call to aid the Frostwolves.

Warmaster Laggrond directs the Horde's fight against the Stormpike Expedition at Alterac Valley's entrance. In the bitter cold, he admits only capable fighters to represent the Frostwolf clan and the wider Horde.

Warmaster Laggrond sends arriving combatants through the Proving Grounds before they enter battle. As warriors fight across the frozen peaks, he measures their standing and honors those who earn renown among the Frostwolves.
